sources.snippet: ComfyUI only uses the Hi3D core for reference-image + coarse-mesh geometry refinement. Image-to-3D and PBR extensions belong to the standalone workbench. This model repository contains neither the application nor Python. GitHub Releases contain code only; T8star will provide the complete package ...
